description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain placement strategies, specifically testing elasticity and load balancing behaviors in a simulated cluster environment. It defines a test class with multiple test methods that verify how the system handles adding/removing silos, load conditions, and placement policies.

classes.name: ElasticPlacementTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for Orleans grain placement and elasticity behaviors, including adding/removing silos and load conditions.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with silo configurator.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_CatchingUp
methods.description: Tests grain placement behavior when new silos are added, ensuring load balancing.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_StoppingSilos
methods.description: Verifies load redistribution when silos are stopped.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_AllSilosCPUTooHigh
methods.description: Ensures no placement occurs when all silos are at 100% CPU utilization.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_AllSilosOverloaded
methods.description: Ensures no placement occurs when all silos are overloaded.

methods.name: LoadAwareGrainShouldNotAttemptToCreateActivationsOnOverloadedSilo
methods.description: Checks that load-aware placement avoids overloaded silos.

methods.name: LoadAwareGrainShouldNotAttemptToCreateActivationsOnBusySilos
methods.description: Checks that load-aware placement avoids busy silos.

methods.name: GetGrainAtSilo
methods.description: Retrieves a grain located at a specific silo.

methods.name: AssertIsInRange
methods.description: Asserts that a value is within a specified range.

methods.name: ElasticityGrainPlacementTest
methods.description: Performs a test to verify placement behavior when silos are tainted or restored.

methods.name: AddTestGrains
methods.description: Activates a specified number of test grains.

methods.name: InvokeAllGrains
methods.description: Invokes a no-op on all grains to simulate activity.

methods.name: GetPerSiloActivationCounts
methods.description: Retrieves activation counts per silo for verification.

methods.name: LogCounts
methods.description: Logs activation counts for each silo.
